== ISXOgreEQ2.Game ==

${ISXOgreEQ2.Game.Busy}
  kind: member of ISXOgreEQ2.Game
  what: Whether a login or camp started by ISXOgreEQ2.Game:Login or :Camp is still running. It goes FALSE when the flow finishes, times out or is aborted.
  returns: bool: TRUE while a login or camp is in progress; FALSE when idle.
  example: echo ${ISXOgreEQ2.Game.Busy}

${ISXOgreEQ2.Game.State}
  kind: member of ISXOgreEQ2.Game
  what: The step the login or camp flow is on, as a short phrase such as login: wait for login screen or camp: wait for camp to complete. It reads idle when nothing is running.
  returns: string: the current login/camp step; idle when nothing is running.
  example: echo ${ISXOgreEQ2.Game.State}

ISXOgreEQ2.Game:Abort
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.Game
  what: Stops a login or camp that ISXOgreEQ2.Game:Login or :Camp started, resumes the bot if the camp had paused it, and prints aborted. Does nothing when nothing is running.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.Game:Abort

ISXOgreEQ2.Game:Camp[mode]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.Game
  what: Camps out the current character, pausing the bot first and retrying the camp once if it fails; a failed camp resumes the bot if it was running. It refuses with a console line when you are not in the world or are in combat, and with no word it camps to the login screen and then closes the InnerSpace session.
  arg mode (string, default: ""): where to stop: charselect (or cs, select) camps to character select and stays; login (or loginscene, loginscreen) camps to the login screen and stays; empty or any other word camps to the login screen and closes the session
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.Game:Camp[charselect]

ISXOgreEQ2.Game:ConvertAccounts[overwrite]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.Game
  what: Copies every account and character from the legacy OldBot file EQ2OgreCommon/DoNotShareWithOthers/EQ2Chars.xml into the account store OgreSavePrivate/EQ2/Accounts.json, and prints how many it wrote. If the store already holds data it refuses with a console line unless you pass overwrite; the XML file is left untouched.
  arg overwrite (string, default: ""): overwrite, force or TRUE to replace an existing account store; anything else, or nothing, keeps it
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.Game:ConvertAccounts

ISXOgreEQ2.Game:Login[character]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.Game
  what: Logs the named character in from the saved account store, on its only or default server unless -s,<server> follows the name, and as whatever class it was unless -c,<class> does: it fills the login screen, clicks Connect, picks the character at character select if it stops there (first 10 slots only), and when that list does not hold it enters the world on the first listed character the account can play and camps to the login screen to log in from there, waiting up to 180 s to reach the world. It runs over the next frames with progress on the console; it stops with a message when no name is given, the character is locked, every listed character is locked, you are already in as that character, or no saved login exists for it, and if you are in the world on another character it first camps that one (not in combat, bot paused for the camp).
  arg character (string): the character to log in; its account, password and server come from the saved account store
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.Game:Login[${Me.Name}]


== ISXOgreEQ2.GetQuest ==

ISXOgreEQ2.GetQuest:Help
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.GetQuest
  what: Prints the `ogre getquest` usage lines (start, list, reload, status, stop) to the console, with the reminder that you must stand next to the NPC because it does not walk.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.GetQuest:Help

ISXOgreEQ2.GetQuest:List
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.GetQuest
  what: Prints every loaded quest row: the quest name, the NPC to hail, the wanted step and the zones it is for, with rows that were never checked against the live game marked [UNVERIFIED]. Prints a warning when no rows are loaded.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.GetQuest:List

ISXOgreEQ2.GetQuest:Reload
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.GetQuest
  what: Re-reads the quest rows from the shipped files (Scripts/Ogre/EQ2/GetQuest/default) and your own (Scripts/OgreSave/EQ2/GetQuest/custom) and prints how many loaded. It is refused with a warning while a run is active.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.GetQuest:Reload

ISXOgreEQ2.GetQuest:Start
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.GetQuest
  what: For the zone you are in (`ogre getquest`), hails the configured NPC and takes its quest, then deletes it from your journal and takes it again until it lands on the wanted step or the row's attempt cap (50 by default) runs out; it never walks, so stand within 15 units of the NPC first. It runs on the bot's action queue and refuses with one line while already running, out of the world, or when no row exists for the zone; it turns on the Do Not Accept Quests setting at the start and puts it back when the run ends, and a round that fails (NPC out of range, no conversation) prints why and ends the run; only a wrong step takes another round.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.GetQuest:Start

ISXOgreEQ2.GetQuest:Status
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.GetQuest
  what: Prints whether a quest reroll is running or idle, how many rows are loaded, your zone, the last result, and the session's run, success and failure counts.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.GetQuest:Status

ISXOgreEQ2.GetQuest:Stop
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.GetQuest
  what: Aborts a running quest reroll, restores the Do Not Accept Quests setting and prints 'getquest: aborted (auto-accept restored).', and a round already under way stops at its next step. When nothing is running it prints 'getquest: not running.' instead.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.GetQuest:Stop


== ISXOgreEQ2.HarvestLite ==

ISXOgreEQ2.HarvestLite:Interval[ms]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.HarvestLite
  what: Sets how often the light harvester runs a pass, in milliseconds (250 to 10000, default 500), and prints the new value; it is not saved. A missing, non-numeric or out-of-range value is refused with a warning and nothing changes.
  arg ms (int): milliseconds between passes, 250 to 10000
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.HarvestLite:Interval[1000]

ISXOgreEQ2.HarvestLite:Off
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.HarvestLite
  what: Turns the light harvester off (`ogre end hl`): no more scans or harvests from the next frame, and it prints 'harvestlite: off'. Your current target is left as it is.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.HarvestLite:Off

ISXOgreEQ2.HarvestLite:On
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.HarvestLite
  what: Turns the light harvester on (`ogre hl`; it starts off and the switch is not saved): every 500 ms it double-clicks your target when that is a resource node within reach (5 units plus both model sizes), and when you have no target, are not moving or casting and have no loot window open it targets the nearest node in reach through the bot's targeting, paused or not. It never walks to a node, drops the node while you are in combat with something within 15 units targeting you, and prints 'harvestlite: ON'.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.HarvestLite:On

ISXOgreEQ2.HarvestLite:Status
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.HarvestLite
  what: Prints the light harvester's state: on or off, the pass interval, the reach, threat and scan radius, its pass, scan, harvest, target and back-off counts, whether a combat back-off is holding, and what it last did.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.HarvestLite:Status


== ISXOgreEQ2.Heartstone ==

ISXOgreEQ2.Heartstone:Now
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.Heartstone
  what: Makes the next Rekindle Bond attempt happen right away instead of waiting out the 15 to 30 minute timer, or looks for a Heartstone now if none has been found yet. It is refused with a warning while the helper is off, and an attempt still does nothing unless you are within 6 units of the Heartstone.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.Heartstone:Now

ISXOgreEQ2.Heartstone:Off
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.Heartstone
  what: Turns the Heartstone helper off (`ogre end heartstone`): no more scans or rekindles, and it prints 'heartstone: disabled'. This is not saved, so the helper is on again after the extension reloads.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.Heartstone:Off

ISXOgreEQ2.Heartstone:On
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.Heartstone
  what: Turns the Heartstone helper back on, prints 'heartstone: ENABLED' and looks again for a Heartstone within 200 units about 3 seconds later. The helper is on by default and works whether or not OgreBot is running: after each zone-in it looks for a Heartstone and, once found, uses Rekindle Bond on it at a random 15 to 30 minute interval, waiting while you are dead or camping out and skipping that turn when you are more than 6 units away.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.Heartstone:On

ISXOgreEQ2.Heartstone:Status
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.Heartstone
  what: Prints the guild-hall Heartstone helper's state (`ogre heartstone`): on or off, whether it has found a Heartstone in this zone, the 6-unit reach, the 15 to 30 minute wait, and its scan, attempt and rekindle counts.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.Heartstone:Status


== ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects ==

ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects:Clear
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects
  what: Un-hides every hidden effect on this client.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects:Clear

ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects:Delete[id]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects
  what: Un-hides one effect by its id. With no id, or one that is not a positive number, it prints a line and changes nothing.
  arg id (int64): The effect id, as the game's hidden list shows it.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects:Delete[123456]

ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects:End
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects
  what: Stops a run and closes the panel, the same as `ogre end hideeffects` and the panel's X. What is already hidden stays hidden.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects:End

ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects:List
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects
  what: Asks the game to print its list of hidden effects in the EQ2 chat window.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects:List

ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects:Open
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects
  what: Opens the Hide Effects panel.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects:Open

ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects:Reload
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects
  what: Re-reads the effect list from disk, off the pulse.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects:Reload

ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects:Reset
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects
  what: Removes your custom additions to the effect list.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects:Reset

ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects:Run
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects
  what: Runs the hide pass now: walks your effects and hides everything the list claims for your class, the same as bare `ogre hideeffects`.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects:Run

ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects:Status
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects
  what: Prints what is loaded, what applies to this character and how the last run went to the console. It makes no server call.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.HideEffects:Status


== ISXOgreEQ2.HUDs ==

${ISXOgreEQ2.HUDs.Diag}
  kind: member of ISXOgreEQ2.HUDs
  what: One diagnostic line about the on-screen HUD overlay: whether it is open, which HUD parts are switched on, whether you are in a raid, whether the group or raid part is the one showing, how many updates it has sent and whether the UI host is up. Reading it does one game read and changes nothing.
  returns: string: space-separated key=value pairs describing the HUD overlay's state.
  example: echo ${ISXOgreEQ2.HUDs.Diag}

ISXOgreEQ2.HUDs:Authorized[names]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.HUDs
  what: Replaces the list of character names the HUD's nearest-player alert ignores with one comma-separated list; names match in any case. No argument, or an empty one, clears the list (your group and raid never set the alert off anyway).
  arg names (string, default: ""): character names separated by commas, no spaces
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.HUDs:Authorized["Bob,Alice"]

ISXOgreEQ2.HUDs:Close
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.HUDs
  what: Closes the on-screen HUD overlay and leaves the switched-on parts as they are. Setting a raid message line or switching a HUD part on later opens it again.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.HUDs:Close

ISXOgreEQ2.HUDs:Open
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.HUDs
  what: Opens the on-screen HUD overlay - a click-through layer that shows the nearest NPC, group or raid member distances and the raid message lines, for the parts that are switched on. If its files cannot be read or the UI host is not up it stays closed and only the log says why.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.HUDs:Open

ISXOgreEQ2.HUDs:Set[key,value]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.HUDs
  what: Sets one HUD overlay setting by key: a part on or off, a display option, or a position. Switching the npc, group, raid or raidopts part on opens the overlay if it is closed, switching one off never closes it, and an unknown key is ignored.
  arg key (string): parts (on/off): npc, group, raid, raidopts; options (on/off): hidename, hidecasting, grouphidename, grouphidecasting, raidonly; positions and spacing (numbers): npcx, npcy, groupx, groupy, groupinc, raidx, raidy, raidinc, raidspacer, raidgap, raidoptx, raidopty, raidoptinc; namewidth and groupnamewidth (1-40, the raid and group name column width). Case does not matter
  arg value (string): 1, TRUE or on to switch on (anything else is off), or the number for a position key
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.HUDs:Set[group,TRUE]

ISXOgreEQ2.HUDs:SetOption[slot,text,displaySecs,removeSecs,minUpdateSecs]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.HUDs
  what: Writes one raid message line on the HUD overlay, with an optional countdown after the text, and removes it after removeSecs; minUpdateSecs then makes the line ignore further writes for that long. A non-empty text opens the overlay if it is closed and empty text blanks the line; a slot outside 1-10 is ignored, and a call without a slot and text prints one usage line.
  arg slot (int): which raid message line, 1 to 10
  arg text (string): the text to show; empty blanks the line
  arg displaySecs (int, default: 0): seconds of countdown shown after the text; 0 shows no countdown
  arg removeSecs (int, default: 30): seconds until the line is removed; 0 or less means 30
  arg minUpdateSecs (int, default: 0): seconds the line ignores further writes (an empty write still clears it); 0 or less means no lock
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.HUDs:SetOption[1,"Next add in:",20,25]

ISXOgreEQ2.HUDs:Test[on]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.HUDs
  what: TRUE loads five demo raid message lines (10 s countdown, gone after 15 s) at once, opening the overlay if it is closed; FALSE, or no argument, clears all ten lines if the demo was loaded. A second TRUE does nothing until a FALSE in between.
  arg on (bool, default: FALSE): 1, TRUE or on loads the demo lines; anything else clears them
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.HUDs:Test[TRUE]


== ISXOgreEQ2.IC ==

${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.FileArgs}
  kind: member of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: The IC File Args text from the IC window (or set with IC:SetFileArgs or the -fileArgs option). A running zone also sees it in its values as options.fileArgs.
  returns: string: the IC File Args text; "" when none.
  example: echo ${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.FileArgs}

${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.FileOption[n]}
  kind: member of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Whether IC File Option n (1, 2 or 3) is ticked in the IC window; what each one means is up to the zone file. Any n outside 1-3 reads NULL.
  arg n (int): which IC File Option, 1 to 3
  returns: bool: TRUE when that option is ticked; FALSE when not; NULL for n outside 1-3.
  example: echo ${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.FileOption[1]}

${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.FileOptionLabel[n]}
  kind: member of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: The text the IC window shows for IC File Option n: a label set with IC:SetFileOptionLabel, else the zone file's own label (the running file, else the one selected in the window), else "IC File Option n". Any n outside 1-3 reads NULL.
  arg n (int): which IC File Option, 1 to 3
  returns: string: the option's label as shown; NULL for n outside 1-3.
  example: echo ${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.FileOptionLabel[2]}

${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.Loaded}
  kind: member of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: The number of zone files IC has loaded. It reads 0 until IC first reads its folders, which happens on Reload or the first IC call that needs them (reading this member does not load them).
  returns: int: how many zone files are loaded; 0 before the first load.
  example: echo ${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.Loaded}

${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.MaxWait}
  kind: member of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Max wait per zone, in seconds (default 3600, saved with the IC settings); 0 waits forever. A zone script still running past it is scored failed (the script itself is not ended) and a steps zone is stopped, and time spent with IC paused or staying in zone until a zone is ready does not count.
  returns: int: seconds a zone may run; 0 means no limit.
  example: echo ${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.MaxWait}

${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.Note}
  kind: member of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Why the current or last run ended, such as "reported complete", a failure reason or "by user" after a stop. It is cleared when a new run starts.
  returns: string: the end reason of the last run; "" while a run is going or before any.
  example: echo ${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.Note}

${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.Paused}
  kind: member of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Whether IC's own pause is on (set by Pause, the IC window, a halt at end of zone or a no-trade shiny). This is not OgreBot's pause.
  returns: bool: TRUE while IC is paused; FALSE otherwise.
  example: echo ${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.Paused}

${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.RunId}
  kind: member of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: The id of the current or last run, a short hex text that is new each time a zone file starts. The run's values are also saved as OgreSave/EQ2/IC/runs/<RunId>.json; each run start deletes the ones over 7 days old.
  returns: string: the current or last run's id; "" before any zone has started.
  example: echo ${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.RunId}

${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.Running}
  kind: member of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Whether a run is in flight: TRUE while IC is zoning in, launching a zone script or running a zone. FALSE when idle, done or failed.
  returns: bool: TRUE while a run is zoning in, launching or running; FALSE otherwise.
  example: echo ${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.Running}

${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.RunState}
  kind: member of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Where the current or last run stands, as a word: idle, zoning in, launching, running, done or failed.
  returns: string: "idle", "zoning in", "launching", "running", "done" or "failed".
  example: echo ${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.RunState}

${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.State}
  kind: member of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: IC's whole state as JSON text: zone files loaded and skipped, its folders, both pauses, the run (state, id, zone, script, step, verdict, max wait), the list and the lockout table. A bare ${ISXOgreEQ2.IC} returns the same text.
  returns: string: IC's state as one JSON object.
  example: echo ${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.State}

${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.Validation}
  kind: member of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: The answer of the last IC:Validate, as JSON: ok (true when the file would load), errors and warnings (how many), and issues - one for each line it printed, with the list and the step it belongs to (counted from 1), the message, and whether it is only a warning. Empty until IC:Validate has run.
  returns: string: JSON, for example {"ok":true,"errors":0,"warnings":0,"issues":[]}; "" before the first IC:Validate.
  example: echo ${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.Validation}
  more: https://kannkor.github.io/ISXOgre/EQ2/bot/developer/zone-files/builder

${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.Value[key]}
  kind: member of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: The run's values that IC publishes for the zone file to read (zone, options, run, list, group and more): bare, the whole document as JSON text; with a key, one dotted key such as zone.fullName or run.completed.1 (arrays count from 1, keys are case-sensitive). True/false values read TRUE or FALSE, objects and arrays read as JSON text, an absent key reads NULL and a key that holds empty text reads empty.
  arg key (string): a dotted key into the values, such as zone.fullName or options.fileArgs; leave it off for the whole document
  returns: string: the whole values document as JSON, or one value as text; NULL before any run, for an absent key, or for a key that holds empty text.
  example: echo ${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.Value[zone.fullName]}

${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.Verdict}
  kind: member of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: The run's verdict: idle (nothing has run), pending (a run is in flight), completed, completedWithFailures (a steps zone ended but a step did not do its job) or failed. A skipped zone and a stopped zone script run read completed, while a stopped steps zone or a stopped zone-in reads failed.
  returns: string: "idle", "pending", "completed", "completedWithFailures" or "failed".
  example: echo ${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.Verdict}

${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.Zone}
  kind: member of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: The full zone name (with its difficulty) of the current or last run. It is set when a zone file starts, so while IC is still zoning in it names the last zone.
  returns: string: the run's full zone name; "" before any zone has started.
  example: echo ${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.Zone}

${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.ZoneEnd}
  kind: member of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Where a script zone's zone end stands after it called IC:ZoneEnd: none (not asked), busy (calling the group to the guild hall or staying in the zone), halted (halt at end of zone, waiting for Resume), zoneOut (zone out now), calledGH (the group is in the guild hall, so do not zone out) or ghFailed (the call failed; end the zone as usual). It goes back to none when a new run starts or the run is stopped.
  returns: string: "none", "busy", "halted", "zoneOut", "calledGH" or "ghFailed".
  example: echo ${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.ZoneEnd}

ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Check[zone]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Prints which zone files claim a zone (exact or prefix match) and whether the zone is available according to the lockout table; no zone means the one you are in. When the table is out of date it asks for a fresh read and says to ask again shortly, except while IC is paused, you are out of the world or a read is already pending, when it only says the table is not fresh.
  arg zone (string): the zone name to check; leave it off for your current zone
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Check["${Zone.Name}"]

ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Complete[note]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: For a zone run by a script: marks the run completed, so it is scored COMPLETED when the script exits, while a script that exits without calling this is scored FAILED. It does not end the run, prints nothing, does nothing when no run is in flight, and a steps zone, which completes itself, refuses it with one line.
  arg note (string): optional text kept as the run's note; empty gives "reported complete"
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Complete["all nameds killed"]

ISXOgreEQ2.IC:End
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Closes IC out, the same as the IC window's X and `ogre end ic`: the window closes, IC's pause clears, and a running zone and list stop as with Stop. Unlike Stop it does not cancel end-of-list actions already under way and says nothing when nothing is running.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.IC:End

ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Fail[reason]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Ends the current run at once as FAILED with the reason, printed on the console; a zone script keeps running, a steps zone stops at its current step without its exit steps, and a zone-in stops its route. Does nothing when no run is in flight.
  arg reason (string): why it failed; empty gives "the script reported failure", or on a steps zone "IC:Fail was called with no reason"
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Fail["group member missing"]

ISXOgreEQ2.IC:List[filter]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Prints every loaded zone file (folder, path, zone, difficulties, and [delegates] for one that hands off to another file or a script) and a count. A filter keeps only files whose zone or path contains it, any case, with its words joined by a space.
  arg filter (string): text to match in the zone name or file path; leave it off to list all
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.IC:List[Zobboz]

ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Open
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Opens the IC window, the same as `ogre ic`. Already open does nothing, and it warns when the UI host is not available.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Open

ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Options[switches...]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Sets IC options by switch: -<option> turns a tick-box on and -<option>=off turns it off (on, off, true, false, 1, 0, yes or no, any case), while -afterWipe=, -maxWait=, -fileArgs= and -stopAfterZone take values. No argument prints every option and its state; changes are saved and reported in one line, and switches that could not be set are listed.
  arg switches... (string): one or more option switches, each starting with -
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Options[-loop,-skipShinies=off,-maxWait=5400]

ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Pause
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Turns on IC's own pause, which stops IC moving the zone and the list along while OgreBot, and any fight already under way, keep going. Prints "IC PAUSED" when it changes, and time paused does not count against the max wait.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Pause

ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Queue[action,args...]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Edits the IC list: add,<tier>,<path>, add,<tier>,<zone name> or add,<zone name> adds a zone file, startat,<row>,<N> makes that row start at step N (N of 1 or less clears it), and clear empties the list. No action, or any other word, prints the list, and add or startat without their arguments is refused.
  arg action (string): add, startat or clear; anything else or nothing prints the list
  arg args... (string): the action's arguments: a tier and path or a zone name for add, a row and step number for startat
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Queue[add,default,"Rage of Cthurath/_04_Zon_Zobboz_The_Graftwerk.json"]

ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Refresh
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Marks IC's cached zone lockout table out of date, so the next check reads it from the game again. Prints "lock table invalidated - it re-seeds on the next check".
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Refresh

ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Reload
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Re-reads every zone file from IC's folders and prints "N zone(s) from M file(s) - X skipped, Y warning(s)". Same as the IC window's Reload and `ogre ic reload`.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Reload

ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Resume
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Clears IC's own pause and prints "IC resumed" when it changes. It is also how you go on after a halt at end of zone or a pause for a no-trade shiny.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Resume

ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Run[tier,relPath]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Starts one zone file (not the list): when you are not in its zone and the travel data knows the way, IC first takes the group there, then a zone that hands off to a script launches it with no arguments (the script reads ${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.Value}) and a steps zone runs its own steps. It refuses with a console line when you are not in the world, a run is already in flight, IC is paused, OgreBot has no profile loaded, or the file is missing, not valid or disabled.
  arg tier (string): which zone file folder: default (the shipped files) or custom (your own, under OgreSave/EQ2/IC/custom)
  arg relPath (string): the zone file's path inside that folder; further arguments are joined to it with a space
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Run[default,"Rage of Cthurath/_04_Zon_Zobboz_The_Graftwerk.json"]

ISXOgreEQ2.IC:RunList[row]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Starts the queued list from a row (1-based, default the top); a row the queue does not have, or one that is not a number, prints "no row N (the queue has M)" and starts nothing. It refuses with a console line when you are not in the world, a run or the end-of-list actions are still going, or the queue is empty.
  arg row (int, default: 1): the list row to start at, counting from 1
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.IC:RunList[2]

ISXOgreEQ2.IC:SetFileArgs[text]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Sets the IC File Args text and saves it; no argument clears it. Only the first argument is used, so quote text that holds commas.
  arg text (string): the new IC File Args text; empty clears it
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.IC:SetFileArgs["fast loot"]

ISXOgreEQ2.IC:SetFileOptionLabel[n,text]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Sets the text the IC window shows for IC File Option n (1-3); empty text goes back to the zone file's own label or "IC File Option n". The label is cleared when the next zone starts, and n outside 1-3 prints a warning.
  arg n (int): which IC File Option, 1 to 3
  arg text (string): the label to show; empty restores the default
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.IC:SetFileOptionLabel[1,"Kill the optional named"]

ISXOgreEQ2.IC:SetMaxWait[seconds]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Sets Max wait per zone in seconds and saves it; 0 waits forever. A fraction rounds up, a number below 0 becomes 1 and a huge one is held at the largest value, while text that is not a number (or no argument) changes nothing, each with a console line.
  arg seconds (number): seconds a zone may run; 0 means no limit
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.IC:SetMaxWait[5400]

ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Status
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Prints IC's report on the console: zone files loaded and their folders, both pauses, the lockout table, the run, its verdict and max wait, the current step, the list and the options that are on. Same as `ogre ic status`.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Status

ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Stop
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Stops the run and the list where they stand and clears IC's pause: a zone script is no longer tracked but is NOT ended, and a steps zone stops at its current step without running its exit steps. With nothing running it cancels end-of-list actions still under way, or prints "nothing is running" (same as the IC window's End and `ogre ic stop`).
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Stop

ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Validate[tier,path]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Checks one zone file by the same rules the Instance Controller uses when it loads zone files, and changes nothing: a file on disk by its tier and path (the same as `ogre ic validate`), or the base64 text of a zone file's JSON. It prints whether the file would load and each problem, and keeps the answer for IC.Validation.
  arg tier (string): The root the zone file is in: default or custom. With no path, this one argument is read as the base64 text of a zone file's JSON.
  arg path (string, default: none): The zone file's path inside that root, ending in .json.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Validate[custom,"My_Zone.json"]
  more: https://kannkor.github.io/ISXOgre/EQ2/bot/developer/zone-files/builder

ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Value[key]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Prints the run's values on the console: no key prints the whole document and the path of its saved copy, a dotted key prints one value, "" (empty) for empty text, or "NULL (absent)". Before any run it prints "no values - nothing has run yet"; a script reads values with ${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.Value[key]} instead.
  arg key (string): a dotted key such as zone.fullName; leave it off to print the whole document
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Value[zone.fullName]

ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Wipe
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Declares a wipe now: a steps zone that is running its enter or steps list stops and runs its wipe recovery. Out of the world, or with no such zone running, it prints why and does nothing.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Wipe

ISXOgreEQ2.IC:ZoneEnd
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.IC
  what: Called by a zone script where it would zone out: IC runs the zone end a steps zone gets (halt at end of zone, then Call to GH after each zone or Stay in zone until a zone is ready, as ticked), and the script then reads ${ISXOgreEQ2.IC.ZoneEnd} until it is not busy or halted. With no zone script running, or on a steps zone, it prints a warning and does nothing.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.IC:ZoneEnd


== ISXOgreEQ2.InvOps ==

${ISXOgreEQ2.InvOps.Busy}
  kind: member of ISXOgreEQ2.InvOps
  what: TRUE while an inventory flow started through this object (Overflow, MoveBag or Trade) is running. Only one of the three runs at a time, and starting another while one runs is refused with a busy warning.
  returns: bool: TRUE while an overflow, bag move or trade flow is running; FALSE when idle.
  example: echo ${ISXOgreEQ2.InvOps.Busy}

${ISXOgreEQ2.InvOps.Status}
  kind: member of ISXOgreEQ2.InvOps
  what: One line naming the running inventory flow and its progress, or "idle". It is the same text `${ISXOgreEQ2.InvOps}` returns.
  returns: string: "idle", "overflow (N popped)", "mbc (done/total)" or "trade (done/total)".
  example: echo ${ISXOgreEQ2.InvOps.Status}

ISXOgreEQ2.InvOps:MoveBag[from,to]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.InvOps
  what: The engine behind `ogre mbc`: moves every item in carried bag `from` into bag `to`, one item every 0.2 s, where a bag's number is its inventory slot (1-6). It is refused with a console warning when a number is missing or out of range, both are the same bag, a slot holds no bag, the source bag is empty, or another inventory flow is running.
  arg from (int): bag number (1-6) to empty
  arg to (int): bag number (1-6) to move the items into
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.InvOps:MoveBag[2,3]

ISXOgreEQ2.InvOps:Overflow
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.InvOps
  what: The engine behind `ogre overflow`: pops items out of the overflow window into your bags, one every 0.2 s, until the game says the overflow is empty or has no room, only one bag slot is left free, or 300 items have been popped. It returns at once and the work runs on later frames; it is refused with a console warning when another inventory flow is running or you are not in the world.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.InvOps:Overflow

ISXOgreEQ2.InvOps:Stop
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.InvOps
  what: Drops whichever overflow, bag move or trade flow is running, without printing anything; does nothing when idle. An open trade window is left as it is.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.InvOps:Stop

ISXOgreEQ2.InvOps:Trade[count]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.InvOps
  what: The engine behind `ogre trade`: opens a trade with your current target, adds up to `count` whole stacks from your bags of the item you have EXAMINED (exact name, any case), then accepts. You need a target and an open examine window; when nothing is examined or no stack matches, the run rejects the trade it opened and ends with a console line.
  arg count (int, default: 12): most stacks to hand over; missing, not a whole number, or 0 or less uses 12
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.InvOps:Trade[4]


== ISXOgreEQ2.Lag ==

ISXOgreEQ2.Lag:Budget[first,second]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.Lag
  what: Sets the two frame budgets the reports count against and saves them, then prints them. A first budget of 1 ms or less, or a second that is not above it, is not taken; with either value missing it prints one warning.
  arg first (float): The first budget in ms.
  arg second (float): The second budget in ms, above the first.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.Lag:Budget[33,50]

ISXOgreEQ2.Lag:Clear
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.Lag
  what: Clears the recorded frames; recording carries on.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.Lag:Clear

ISXOgreEQ2.Lag:Close
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.Lag
  what: Closes the Lag window, the same as `ogre end lag`. The ledger keeps recording; :Off stops it.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.Lag:Close

ISXOgreEQ2.Lag:Dump[seconds]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.Lag
  what: Writes the recorded frames to the dump file and says where.
  arg seconds (float): How far back to dump. Optional: everything recorded when left out.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.Lag:Dump[120]

ISXOgreEQ2.Lag:Minutes[minutes]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.Lag
  what: Sets how many minutes of frames the ledger holds, saves it, and starts the ledger empty. With no value it prints one warning and changes nothing.
  arg minutes (int): Minutes to hold, held between 1 and 60.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.Lag:Minutes[10]

ISXOgreEQ2.Lag:Off
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.Lag
  what: Turns the ledger off and saves it: nothing is recorded, and the frames already recorded are kept.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.Lag:Off

ISXOgreEQ2.Lag:On
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.Lag
  what: Turns the ledger on and saves it: every frame is recorded.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.Lag:On

ISXOgreEQ2.Lag:Open
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.Lag
  what: Opens the Lag window, the same as bare `ogre lag`.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.Lag:Open

ISXOgreEQ2.Lag:Overhead
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.Lag
  what: Prints what the ledger itself costs per frame to the console.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.Lag:Overhead

ISXOgreEQ2.Lag:Report[seconds]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.Lag
  what: Prints the report for the last stretch of frames to the console: frame rate, stability, and what cost the most.
  arg seconds (float): How far back to look. Optional: 60 when left out.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.Lag:Report[30]

ISXOgreEQ2.LevelTransmuting:Off

ISXOgreEQ2.LevelTransmuting:Open

ISXOgreEQ2.LevelTransmuting:Status

ISXOgreEQ2.LootScan:Interval[ms]
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.LootScan

  arg ms (int): The scan interval in milliseconds, 500 to 30000.
  example: ISXOgreEQ2.LootScan:Interval[2000]

ISXOgreEQ2.LootScan:Reset
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.LootScan
  what: Forgets which actors were looted, so they are looked at again.

ISXOgreEQ2.LootScan:Status
  kind: method of ISXOgreEQ2.LootScan
